title: Umpire: Portable Memory Management for High-Performance Computing Applications
problem: Modern HPC systems have complex memory hierarchies with multiple types (CPU DRAM, NUMA, GPUs, high-bandwidth memory). Efficient management while maintaining portability across architectures is challenging for application developers.
motivation: Hardware diversity (CPUs with NUMA, multiple GPU types, HBM) requires sophisticated memory management. Manual optimization is error-prone and non-portable. Need unified abstraction layer.
method: Umpire library provides unified, portable memory management API for HPC platforms. Implements memory pools for efficient allocation. Integrates with RAJA portability suite for end-to-end portability.
key_novelty: Portable memory management abstraction; memory pool optimization achieving 15x+ speedups; integration with RAJA ecosystem.
contributions: Unified memory management API for HPC platforms with multiple memory devices
Memory pool implementation enabling significant performance improvements
Integration with RAJA Portability Suite for complete portability solution

metrics.memory_pool_speedup: 15x or greater speedup from memory pools
metrics.portability: Works across GPU and CPU platforms

limitations: Abstract only; unclear specific benchmarks; memory pool comparison methodology not detailed; no discussion of memory fragmentation or overhead.
